subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------SPT.DYM.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-22 — the section on dynamic-separation in the late-sixties black community (Jesse Jackson, alignment-with-philosophical-positions, vibrational dynamics of split). The prose below identifies the structural target: 'the vibrational dynamics of this period would move to have individuals align themselves with one given philosophical or vibrational position — one that was inherently opposed to any other position.' The crossing diagrams how affinity-postulation structurally meets spiritual-dynamics at the late-sixties alignment scale: AF-POST (affinity postulation — the form's actual affinity-based postulation) crossed with SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). AF-POST sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TR (transformation) branches up-left from the main line, and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from TR. SPT-DYM sits at upper-right as partner-axis. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches right from the main line; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) descends from PROG-CONT, and AFI (affinity insight) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) branch from ACC-DY. RE-ST (restructuralism) descends from the main line near the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) branches from RE-ST, POL-DY (political dynamics) descends from SOC-RT, and PART (participation) branches from POL-DY.
